answer: Bond pricing follows each funding root's realized fault record, not a flat deposit. A first key from a clean root locks 200 POA of escrow across 6 epochs; that root's k-th key must lock 200 times 2^k, so the tenth clone freezes 102,400 POA before its seal counts. Roots come from deposit history, never from declarations: peers audit graded work each epoch, and one proven fault doubles that root's multiplier permanently and slashes every bond open beneath it. Dormant tundra clones hold dead funds, a violet mark discounts clean roots, and a dune of new honest keys pays only the floor.
